[2026-10-15] Remind me how to undo the last git commit.  

To undo the last Git commit while keeping changes staged: `git reset --soft HEAD~1`  
To undo the last Git commit and unstage changes: `git reset --mixed HEAD~1` (default)  
To undo the last Git commit and discard changes: `git reset --hard HEAD~1`  

Use `--soft` to preserve changes in the index, `--mixed` to keep them in the working directory, and `--hard` to remove them entirely. Choose based on whether you want to recommit, edit, or discard the changes.
